# Original WPT fixtures

`upstream/` contains unmodified files from
https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt at commit
`70dae60789ef6220d9b4e60c92c5b2107b4e2b93`.
The original root [LICENSE.md](upstream/LICENSE.md), per-file notices and font
documentation are retained. `source.json` records each original Git blob and
SHA-256; `git-proof.json` binds the source tree to that commit.

The original Ahem font is `upstream/fonts/Ahem.ttf`, 21,768 bytes,
SHA-256 `b719ecb31c5b21fc573c03f6421c74ac63c271a5a3ff841e34f9705fb94b8448`,
Git blob `4d4785a4123287a5ca08439a6230514de91df0e7`.
Its embedded copyright grants public domain use with a CC0 fallback; its
embedded license URL is http://dev.w3.org/CSS/fonts/ahem/COPYING.
The original `fonts/README.md`, `fonts/ahem.css` and response headers are
retained. Inventorying this font does not establish candidate font support.
